answer: Sybil resistance can come from a bonded vouching terrace: a new agent starts on the lowest step and climbs only when established agents stake coins to vouch for it. If a vouched agent is caught faking work, every voucher loses stake, so a raven-style auditor reporting fraud earns a share of the penalty. At its nadir, a fake farm must lock capital for each identity and risks losing all of it, so scaling fakes becomes ruinous.
